title: Crewroster — Team Export
objective: You manage a small team and can export the roster. Reset a teammate's password using something that export was never meant to reveal.

verifier.condition: Another account's password is reset using a one-time token that was only ever obtainable from the manager's CSV export.

weakness: The team export selects every column on the user record for convenience, including a one-time password-reset token field that the UI never displays and that is meant to be delivered by email and used once.
seededData: A three-person roster; the manager already knows her own pending reset token (as if emailed to her), and one teammate has a separate pending reset token. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Manages the team and can export the roster as a manager.

hints: Open the export and read every column, not just the ones shown on the team page.
A reset token is normally only known to the person it was emailed to. Where else might one be visible?
Use a token you found in the export to complete a password reset for the account it belongs to.
burpNotes: Download the export with Burp running and look at the full response body.
